summary: Allows a prepared breaking Release Please candidate to pass merge-queue and publication baseline checks until its version tag is created.
userImpact: EnterpriseGlue 0.11.0 can publish normally after its breaking Release Please pull request passes the protected merge queue.

notes: This release-automation correction does not change the database schema or migration sequence.

documentation: The release-note preflight contract now covers Release Please candidates in GitHub merge groups and the manifest-ahead publication window.
rollback: Revert the release-automation correction if the protected merge-queue metadata contract changes.
validation: Run the release-note contract suite, simulate the prepared 0.11.0 merge-group preflight, and verify the Release Please publication workflow creates the expected tag and release.
Restore an unpublished manifest/changelog pair to the latest real tag before asking Release Please to regenerate the interrupted release candidate.
